plainLanguage: Midland is in climate zone 3B (hot, dry). We could not confirm the city's adopted building code edition, zoning setbacks or fees, so those must be checked with the city before final drawings. Footings should be at least 12 inches below grade. Hail and wind are the main weather risks. Construction labor costs swing with the oil economy.
